findings.title: Apps selection capture restores an obsolete clipboard over a newer copy
findings.reproduction: Run probes/apps-foreign-clipboard.lua: actual selection copy/read completes, first native restore refuses, a new all-type clipboard write succeeds, retained Apps retry overwrites it with prior ORIGINAL; generation API is supplied but read zero times. Healthy no-writer and separate Search preserves-new-generation controls pass. Native board/Quartz/URL ports record only.
findings.root_cause: macos/modules/shortcuts/actions/apps.lua:468-495 restores the old snapshot unconditionally; queue_copy_restore_retry:537 repeats it without a native changeCount/owner receipt.
findings.silent_failure: Refresh/capture/retry logs no ownership change because no generation is observed; newer clipboard content is lost or wrongly searched as the selection.
findings.regression_test: Compose real Apps+broker+scheduler with native count and failed restore; require newer generations including identical-text/new-type changes to win; cover false/nil/throw and late/cancelled retries.

findings.title: Independent macOS clipboard borrowers snapshot another family’s temporary payload
findings.reproduction: Run probes/cross-owner-clipboard.lua: actual Text plain paste borrows original text+HTML; while pending actual Apps copy capture admits and saves Text-only payload. Both settle; original HTML is lost. Plain-paste-alone control restores all types. No external writer, native clipboard or real input is used.
findings.root_cause: Text text_scope/any_text_owner_pending and Apps _copy_capture_in_flight serialize only their own families. Separate snapshot owners lack a common process-global clipboard admission authority, so the second adopts borrowed output as genuine user clipboard.
findings.silent_failure: Each owner correctly retires its own local state; no diagnostic identifies borrowed snapshot provenance, and original non-text types vanish.
findings.regression_test: Use real Text/Apps/Search/senders over one all-type native board; require rejection or queued admission while another family owns snapshot, both ordering permutations, delayed FIFO, cancellation and restoration debt; assert original rich types survive.

findings.title: Ordinary delayed selection transforms paste captured text into another focused app
findings.reproduction: Run probes/transform-focus-switch.lua: actual Text selection_lowercase reads APP_A selection and writes lowercase payload; change mutable window_info native focus/routing to APP_B before delayed paste; real global Cmd+V posts selected words to APP_B and restores original clipboard. Same-focus control targets APP_A. Native effects are recorders.
findings.root_cause: Ordinary Text case/wrap callers supply no continuation receipt; TextContinuation.new(nil) admits forever within parent generation. Paste publication checks owner and clipboard count, not original application/field; global emit_guarded_key_stroke has no target or destination check.
findings.silent_failure: Transformation reports completion and clipboard cleanup succeeds despite stale selected text being pasted and reselected in another document.
findings.regression_test: Capture original destination before ordinary copy and recheck full/cached field authority before paste/reselection. Test app/field/caret change, same-focus control, delayed FIFO, pause and failed cleanup without corrupting clipboard restoration.
